name: PD 474 was established by Ordinance No. 23177, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 11,
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 474 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 474.

PD 474.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-474.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 474 was established by Ordinance No. 23177, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 11, 1997. Ordinance No. 23177 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 23177 was amended by Ordinance No. 23201, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 13, 1997, and Ordinance No. 23788, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 10, 1999. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23177; 23201; 23788; 26042)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-474.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 474 is established on property generally located at the northeast corner of Preston Road and Hughes Lane. The size of PD 474 is approximately 15.1671 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23177; 26042)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-474.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations contained in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 23177; 26042)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-474.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 474A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development plan, the provisions of this article control. [Note: The development plan is incorrectly stamped with Ordinance No. 23787, rather than Ordinance No. 23788.] (Ord. Nos. 23177; 23788; 26042)

sections.title: Exterior Construction Activity
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-474.105. EXTERIOR CONSTRUCTION ACTIVITY.

It is the intent of the city council to minimize construction traffic in residential neighborhoods. Therefore, upon the submission of an application for a building permit on the Property, the applicant must submit a document to the director of public works and transportation defining the proposed routes for construction traffic. (Ord. Nos. 23177; 26042)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-474.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Recreation uses.

-- Private recreation center, club, or area.

(b) Residential uses.

-- Handicapped group dwelling unit. [SUP required if spacing component of Section 51A-4-209(3-1) is not met.] -- Single family.

(c) Transportation uses.

-- Private street or alley. -- Transit passenger shelter.

(d) Utility and public service uses.

-- Electrical substation. [SUP] -- Local utilities. -- Utility or government installation other than listed. [SUP] (Ord. Nos. 23177; 26042)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-474.107. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this PD:

-- Accessory helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. -- Private stable. (Ord. Nos. 23177; 26042)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-474.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(a) Front yard.

(1) Minimum front yard setback for the guard house is as shown on the development plan.

(2) Minimum front yard setback for all other uses is 20 feet.

(b) Side and rear yard.

(1) Minimum side and rear yard setback for the guard house is as shown on the development plan.

(2) Minimum side yard setback for all other uses is 10 feet.

(3) No minimum rear yard setback for lots that abut the floodway (Lots 1, 2, 3, and the northern line of Lot 4).

(4) Minimum rear yard setback for lots that abut adjacent existing development (Lots 5, 6, and the eastern line of Lot 4) is 20 feet for structures less than 12 feet in height and 40 feet for all other structures.

(5) Minimum rear yard setback for interior lots (Lots 7, 8, and 9) is 10 feet.

(c) Number of dwelling units permitted. No more than 10 dwelling units are permitted on the Property.

(d) Floor area ratio. No maximum floor area ratio.

(e) Height. Maximum structure height is 30 feet in Lots 4, 5, 6, and 10. Maximum structure height in Lots 1, 2, 3, 7, 8, and 9 is 35 feet.

(f) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 60 percent for residential structures and 25 percent for nonresidential structures.

(g) Lot size. Minimum lot area for the guard house is as shown on the development plan. Minimum lot area for all other residential uses is 24,000 square feet. No minimum lot area for nonresidential uses. (Ord. Nos. 23177; 23201; 26042)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-474.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Consult the use regulations contained in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations contained in Divisions 51A-4.300 for general information regarding off-street parking and loading generally.

(b) In this district, off-street parking must be provided at or below ground level. (Ord. Nos. 23177; 26042)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-474.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 23177; 26042)

sections.title: Electrical Service For Single Family Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-474.111. ELECTRICAL SERVICE FOR SINGLE FAMILY USES.

In this PD, a lot for a single family use may be supplied by not more than one electrical utility service, and metered by not more than one electrical meter. The board of adjustment may grant a special exception to authorize more than one electrical utility service and more than one electrical meter on a lot in this PD when, in the opinion of the board, the special exception will:

(1) not be contrary to the public interest;

(2) not adversely affect neighboring properties; and

(3) not be used to conduct a use not permitted in this PD. (Ord. Nos. 23177; 26042)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-474.112. ACCESS.

(a) Ingress and egress must be provided as shown on the development plan.

(b) Private street widths must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 23177; 26042)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-474.113. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 474B) and must be completed in accordance with Article X. The proposed perimeter wall, as shown on the landscape plan, must be completed within six months after the issuance of the first building permit on the Property that is issued subsequent to February 10, 1999. All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. [Note: The landscape plan is incorrectly stamped with Ordinance No. 23787, rather than Ordinance No. 23788.] (Ord. Nos. 23788; 26042)

sections.title: Tree Preservation
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-474.114. TREE PRESERVATION.

(a) The regulations contained in Division 51A-10.130, “Tree Preservation,” apply to this PD.

(b) Tree removal applications may not be approved prior to the issuance of a building permit on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 23177; 26042)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-474.115. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 23177; 26042)

sections.title: Sidewalks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-474.116. SIDEWALKS.

Sidewalks are not required within this district. (Ord. Nos. 23788; 26042)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-474.117. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(d) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23788; 26042)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-474.118. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23177; 26042)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-474.119. ZONING MAP.

PD 474 is located on Zoning Map No. C-7. (Ord. Nos. 23177; 26042)
